scientific_question: Does propagating the charged CHORUS state across both interaction layers change the causal contribution of relative edge phase?

scope_contrast.treatment: Persistent CHORUS at every interaction layer.
scope_contrast.comparison_rule: Estimate Full-versus-Aligned within each scope before forming the Persistent-minus-Final interaction contrast.

modes.aligned: Full Hermitian neighbour-pair closure with the relative phase fixed to zero; parameter schema retained.
modes.full: Full Hermitian neighbour-pair closure with learned relative phase.

primary_estimand: Paired log Force-MAE ratio Full versus Aligned within dataset and seed.
selection: Minimum complete-validation Force MAE; test never selects a checkpoint.
fixed_checkpoint_interventions: For MACE-ICTC Persistent-Full, replay the selected checkpoint under aligned, dose, local phase permutation, and common-shift interventions.
claim_boundary: The learned phase is an internal variable. The experiment identifies predictive use of relative phase and its interaction with propagation scope.
